s.how: Toss 1kg chicken wings with salt and bake at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Melt 50g butter with 100ml hot sauce and 2 tbsp honey and toss the wings through. Serve with sour cream mixed with herbs and celery sticks to put the fire out.

Cut a cob loaf in a deep crosshatch without slicing through the base. Mix 100g softened butter with crushed garlic and chopped parsley and push into the cuts with 250g grated mozzarella. Wrap in foil and bake at 180C for 20 minutes, then unwrap for 5 minutes more.

m.how: Rub 2kg beef short ribs with smoked paprika, garlic, brown sugar and salt. Cook uncovered at 140C for 5 hours until a dark crust forms and the meat is tender. Serve with buttered grilled corn and a crunchy cabbage slaw.

w.note: the cosmic storm that hits the space station
w.how: Simmer 250g blueberries with 80g sugar and a splash of water for 8 minutes until jammy, then cool. Scoop vanilla ice cream into tall glasses, spoon over the blueberry sauce and top with whipped cream. Scatter popping candy on top just before serving.

d.how: Fill glasses with crushed ice and a slice of lemon. Pour in cold lemonade and add a drop or two of blue food colouring, stirring until bright blue. Squeeze in a little fresh lemon juice to sharpen it and serve straight away.
